answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Reaching the lagoon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The mirror holds work receipts rather than names, so the lantern of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
